01 / THE PROBLEM

🔍 The Challenge

From a purchase to an emotional bond

The challenge was to make the care behind milk meaningful to families, moving beyond a transactional relationship. The brand needed a story that connected safe, pure dairy products with the everyday care people give their loved ones.

From awareness to accessible home delivery

The wider digital commerce challenge was to connect that brand experience with a hyper-local e-commerce and home-delivery ecosystem in the post-COVID context—bringing online ordering, payments and customer communication into a coordinated journey.

02 / THE SOLUTION & ACTION

🛠️ Three connected areas of work.

01 / STORYTELLING

Campaign & Storytelling

Jotne Thasha Valobasha connected the care behind Aarong Dairy’s milk with familiar moments of family care. I coordinated campaign strategy, communication, creative partners and video production across Facebook and YouTube.

Watch the campaign ↓
02 / TRANSPARENCY

Video Production Coordination

The 7-part documentary series made the milk collection chain understandable through farmer stories, quality checks and operational processes. My contribution included planning, budgeting and scripting.

Explore the documentary ↗
03 / ACCESS

Digital Commerce Infrastructure

I led website and home-delivery launch coordination, connecting SMS and payment gateways with the online customer journey and aligning the teams needed for execution.

Explore digital commerce ↗

These are related workstreams from my Aarong Dairy experience. The documentary playlist is dated 2019 and is a separate production from the Jotne Thasha Valobasha campaign and the e-commerce launch.
